summary: My w16 medium is fixed. The THE Suite floor and the door-bay mats now carry the photo heather. The q03 F floor reads as dark brown cut pile with light flecks, as in f_17300, and it no longer looks like flat paint next to the J aisle. The J aisle is a little calmer at the lower gain, and the re-cut tile has less low-frequency banding. Diffing all 7 shell views against w16 shows changes only on carpet pixels (plus sky and cloud motion in the window views), so everything else is unchanged. No high or medium issues remain. The score stays at 8.5 because the carried low-severity items (door viewing window, pleat contrast, vinyl speckle, sidewall weave, tub-floor card, grille pitch) still separate it from the photos.
renders: w2/shell was empty when rated, so I rendered the 7 views from the w17 build (b6/test.html, carpetF/doorCarpet = LAYER.jCarpet) to scratchpad/ra17/ with review/qa/shell_views.js. The QA views are from w2/qa.

details.note: Unchanged (s01, s04). Clean satin with seams every second window, and no weave.
Unchanged. The F/J short bowl and LED pill are right (s09, ra_jWin). The PY/Y tub-floor card remains.
Unchanged. Close-up pleat contrast is about half the photo's.
Unchanged. The louvre pitch is fine.
Same mauve-brown heather (q06 rgb 64,54,54 vs c_27312 65,55,55). At gain 1.2 the near-aisle high-pass is 6.4, inside the photo range of 4.6-6.2 (+0.2). The tile has less banding.

Now a dark brown heather with light flecks, which matches f_17300 in character. It reads as carpet next to the suite base in q03. Residuals: the f_17300 pile is a coarser, vermiculated pebble (blob ~3-4 px at that scale) while the render is a fine uniform speckle. The render is also a step darker than f_17300's lit floor (L ~48 vs ~57, but q03 is a shaded corner). The hue matches (R-B 18 vs 20).

The ra_door2floor and q01 mats now show pile texture (high-pass 4.7 / 4.0) in a warm grey-brown that is distinct from the vinyl. It reads as an entry mat. It is slightly less textured than the aisle carpets because of distance and viewing angle, which is acceptable.
Unchanged. The viewing window is slightly short, and the housing has no gap to the bezel.
Unchanged grey stone-look vinyl (ra_door2floor rgb 103,99,101, high-pass 2.6). The speckle is low against sans_09.
